static_traits.name: Chen Yaning
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with classmates strained by Self-doubt affecting group activities; although friends and classmates are available to talk to, sharing failure and Self-doubt feels uncomfortable
static_traits.medical_history: No history of similar psychological problems; has not received psychotherapy; no major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Highly cooperative, Positive attitude; self-reported nervousness but willing to communicate; clear expression with self-Reflection ability

basic_info.main_problem: Since failing last month's Japanese exam, I have felt like a failure and consider myself stupid.
basic_info.core_demands: Persistent feelings of failure and doubts about academic ability prompted me to seek counseling to deal with these problems.

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I Fail one exam, it shows I am not smart enough and not suited for this course
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubles study efforts and seeks help from classmates to prove one can be competent
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am stupid / I am a failure

special_situations.event: Whenever encountering difficulties while learning Japanese
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I encounter difficulties in Learning, it proves I have no ability
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Pressures herself and engages in self-criticism, forcing herself to study harder
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This proves again that I am not smart enough

special_situations.event: Thinks about having had successes in homework or class participation that coexist with exam failure
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only formal exams are the true measure of ability; other successes do not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Uses exam scores as the sole standard, ignores other positive performance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Doing well on homework does not matter; this exam shows I am not capable

special_situations.event: Under high pressure before exams because of 'must perform well'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: I must do well on exams and should do better, otherwise I am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Setting perfectionist standards, being strict with oneself

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized and seen as capable
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being judged as stupid or a failure, worrying self-worth will be negated
defense_goal: Maintaining a sense of control through self-reproach and high standards
Avoids exposing vulnerability to others to reduce shame

object_relations.self_representation: A Student not smart enough, possibly failing at any time
A classmate who drags the team down (a Self-doubter)
object_relations.object_representation: Peers who may be disappointed or distant

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When friends or classmates become potential confidants, invited to discuss feelings of failure and Self-doubt
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worries that exposing vulnerability will lead to being slighted or judged as 'stupid'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Avoid expressing emotions deeply; use brief, vague answers, Deflect topics to academic details, keeping a restrained tone.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When facing a formal exam or being asked to evaluate ability by scores
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Viewing exams as the sole and decisive evaluator, thereby avoiding facing shame and fear
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizes words such as 'standards, measurement, objectivity', discusses exam difficulty in an analytical tone, avoiding talking about shame and fear.

manifestations: Treats one exam as the sole measure of self-worth
Experiencing 'I am not worthy' when encountering difficulties in Japanese Learning
Negating successful experiences in homework and class participation
Although friends and classmates are available, unwilling to discuss failure and Self-doubt
outcomes: Support system not yet effectively utilized

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Frequently using self-Demands like 'I should do better'
Treats exam scores as the only authoritative standard

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Self-denial (e.g. 'I am a failure / I am stupid')
Overly cautious or even avoidant when talking about feelings with friends

contact_model.definition: An individual restrains behavioral impulses toward others or things, or gives up seeking others to do something for them, turning instead to oneself; counterpart to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Not seeking emotional support from friends, instead doubling down on Learning and self-criticism

positive_force: Willing to seek help from classmates and study doubly hard (has action tendencies)
Willing to try cognitive restructuring and reality testing (positive attitude)
Having had Good performance in homework or class participation (can serve as evidence of ability)
Has some social support resources (friends and classmates)
negative_force: Overgeneralization and self-labeling; defines oneself by one failure
Negating positive experiences, over-focusing on exam results
External-validation dependence is marked; self-worth highly depends on scores
Repressing emotions and avoiding communication with support systems

target_behavior.behavior: Negative self-talk and self-labels while Learning Japanese (e.g. 'I am stupid', 'I am a failure')
antecedent: Receiving the result of failing the Japanese exam
Encountering difficulties or mistakes while studying
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizes a single failure and binds self-worth to the exam score (overgeneralization, external validation)
target_behavior.function: Avoiding shame and uncertainty, trying to gain control or motivation through self-criticism
target_behavior.consequence: Declining performance in the Japanese course; Relationship tension with classmates; Reduced motivation for other subjects and extracurriculars

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding discussing feelings of failure and Self-doubt with friends or classmates
antecedent: When invited by others or given a chance to share feelings
target_behavior.core_reason: Worries about being judged as stupid or looked down on; shame-driven avoidance
target_behavior.function: Avoiding possible negative evaluation and emotional pain
target_behavior.consequence: Support systems not yet effectively used, Interpersonal alienation worsening
